title: Senior Man Seated at Table in Bright Light, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-century black-and-white square snapshot featuring a mature gentleman seated casually at a table draped in a white tablecloth. He wears a light-colored short-sleeved open-collar shirt and trousers, sitting with his legs crossed in a relaxed posture. Dramatic, high-contrast light streaks across his torso and the tabletop, creating an unintentional chiaroscuro effect against the deep, dark background of the interior room. The scalloped deckle edges and square format are characteristic of 127 or 620 roll film popular in 1950s family photography.
